items.title: Bill Goodwin interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, May 28, 2025
items.q: So I met those guys and we started jamming and playing together

ctx.x: A gig? Well I wasn’t working in the Poconos really much. I would work some local gigs occasionally and they were pretty lame. But then I got in, through Bob I met musicians who had decamped to Pennsylvania. There was Jay Cameron the baritone sax player, owned a music store on Main Street in Stroudsburg, and Bob Newman, the saxophonist from Philadelphia was the band leader at a resort. So I met those guys and we started jamming and playing together but mostly I was playing with Gary and then traveling. And the…
I know exactly what you’re talking about because I was in college right around that time and yeah, the scene for jazz was great in colleges and then it wasn’t.
